Devreden kategoride önceki ayların artan: In a rollover category, what was left in previous months is added to this month's share and overspending is deducted; neither is counted twice. Rollover starts from the month it was turned on, and past months are calculated with today's limit and today's records (if an old transaction's category or the salary day changes, the rollover changes too).
